Navratri vrat men jhatpat banne vala aur oorja se bharpur phalahar, sabudana khichdi. ye har bar ekdam khili-khili nan stiki aur svadisht kaise bane iske liye sabudana bhigone aur kuk karne ke sabhi tips ke sath speshal vidiyo
100% Non-Sticky Sabudana Khichdi Recipe in Hindi for Navratri Fast. Sabudana Khichdi Recipe, How to make non sticky sabudana khichdi, Navratri Vrat Food, Sabudana recipe by Nisha Madhulika.
Ingredients for Non Sticky Sabudana Khichadi
Sabudana - Sabudana - 1 cup
Ghi - Ghee - 3 tbsp
Mungaphli paudar - Peanut Powder - ½ cup
Mungaphli - Peanut - ¼ cup
Aalu - Potato - 1 no.
